messages:
Lina Torres: Planning a coordinated maintenance for ap-east1 GPU racks — Thu 23:00-02:00 UTC. Scope: rolling soft reboots + NIC microcode checks. Estimated impact: ~14% on 'pulse' shared pool. Need backfill plan and console banner.
Ben Howard: How large are cohorts? we should avoid draining same AZ simultaneously.
Kai Zhou: Cohorts of 6 nodes every 25m, spread across AZs. Pulse pool = 140 nodes, Dedicated reserved ~28. Worst-case throughput dip ~12-15%.
Lina Torres: We'll do a canary cohort at 23:00, hold 10m, run probes, then continue. Post-drain cache seed will run automatically.
Ben Howard: For backfill prefer spot instances 70% + 30% on-demand. Quick estimate: 6 on-demand GPUs * $3.0/hr * 3h = $54. I'll tag Finance for approval.
Finance-team: Ack, ping with exact numbers and cost center. Pre-approve up to $120 for burst if tagged.
Kai Zhou: Eviction policy: use `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=420`. We honor `infra/preserve=true` annotation to skip critical pods.
Lina Torres: Health probes: run `python infra/latency_probe.py --pool=pulse --pct=95` before and after each cohort. If 95p > 2x baseline, pause and alert #oncall.
Ben Howard: Routing: temporary fallback to ap-southeast1 for latency-sensitive routes. Egress cost note: minor uptick expected. Add console banner: "Planned maintenance: ap-east1 GPU capacity reduced; auto-fallback to ap-southeast1 enabled."
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: ap-east1-nic-microcode-softreboot (6175000000). Window Thu 23:00-02:00 UTC. Notifying: #customers, #support, #gpucapacity.
Kai Zhou: I'll run a staging dry-run tonight at 20:00 UTC with identical cadence. Will paste results.
Lina Torres: Thanks — will draft customer comms after Finance confirms burst. Ops: set ops-bot to notify oncall 20m before canary.
ops-bot: will notify oncall at 22:40 UTC.
Ben Howard: Runbook snippet:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-77
kubectl drain gpu-node-77 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=420
curl -X POST https://infra-api/internal/seed-cache?pool=pulse
python infra/latency_probe.py --pool=pulse --pct=95
```
Lina Torres: Closing for now. Reopen if probes fail or Finance blocks."
